title: Practice: Switch Kick
source: Practice Mode tutorial. Words from the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Kickboxing › Switch Kick: cues, mistakes, next). Thai: te salap (เตะสลับ), the switch kick. Footage: the owner's clip 23 (ring, 2026-11-03), raw-footage/practice/p23.mp4, two shots joined in InShot (cut at 6.27 s): two switch kicks facing the camera (0.8 and 4.8 s), one from 45° (10.3 s).

props.description: Switch stance to disguise the rear kick

cues.label: SWITCH
cues.say: Coach: "Feet swap in a hop no higher than a step. Rear foot forward, lead foot back."

cues.label: STAY LEVEL
cues.say: Coach: "Head and hips stay level. If you bob, they read the kick."

cues.label: KICK
cues.say: Coach: "The switch and the kick are one beat. Land, and the shin is already on its way."

watch.label: BIG HOP
watch.say: Coach: "A big hop is a flashing sign that says kick. Keep it small and fast."
